sessions.title: Hello and my name

slides.goal: I can say hello and my name.

slides.task: Turn to a partner. Say: “Hello. My name is ___.” Then ask their name.

slides.exit: Names three family members from a picture.

sessions.homePractice: Say today's words aloud with someone at home.

slides.task: Find the letters s, a or t in your name or around the room.
